Dialogs.Dialog: How do you do？ Nice to meet you.
What's with that happy look on your face？
Meeting new people makes me nervous. Nice to meet you.
Um, I'm Rinko Kobayakawa. Nice to meet you.
Not really. ...Or is it that obvious？
I'm in a pretty good mood today.
Hehe, I just feel kind of happy right now.
Not good, not bad, I'd say.
Who knows？ I'm always like this.
Just a little... No, never mind. It's nothing.
Hey, there's something I wanted to ask you...
Hey, it's not really advice, but... I'd like to hear what you think.
No need to hold back, just ask me.
Don't you think you've got that wrong？
I might see it a little differently.
I see. Yeah, that makes sense.
Hmm... Is that really how it is？
Who knows. I'm not really sure.
There's no way I can answer that.
Look at you getting all shy.
You don't have to tell me if you don't want to.
When you act like that, it just makes me want to hear it even more.
It's my turn to ask something next.
Oh! There's something I want to ask.
Huh？ Am I not supposed to say that？
What, I can't talk about this either？
So, how are things with your boyfriend lately？
I don't think I can even imagine life without him anymore. ...Not that I want to, anyway. Hehe.
When I'm with him, my chest gets all tight. You know？ Like my heart's being squeezed.
I think I might be broken beyond repair. I literally can't think about anything but him.
It feels like me and him are two halves of a whole. Nobody can get between us... or something like that▼
We don't even have to say 'let's stay together forever' out loud... I can tell just by looking into his eyes▼
I love him so much, I don't even know how to express it anymore. Apparently he feels the same way, though. Hehe▼
We're actually in a fight right now... I want to make up, but it's not that easy.
We got into a little fight. I'm planning on making up with him, but it's not going so well.
We're fighting right now... Ugh, how did things end up like this？
Well, maybe a change of pace will help you be more honest with him？
If you want to make up, I'm sure he can probably tell too.
Um, so... what's it like getting affectionate with your boyfriend？
Hey, how are things with physical affection？ Like... is that going well？
So, is your boyfriend... a good kisser？
Things are pretty good with us... I think. It makes me feel happy.
My boyfriend might actually be pretty good at it. Not to brag or anything.
Hmm, I don't know. If I can't tell, maybe he's not all that good at it.
It's nothing special, really... Not that I dislike it or anything.
Say... when you want some physical affection, do you think it's better to drop a hint？
We don't really kiss all that much... Is that weird？
How have your dates been lately？ Having fun？
We've been stopping by places after school and stuff. I'm having a pretty good time.
Well, we're just enjoying normal dates, I guess.
The other day, we made a really special memory. Just thinking back on it makes me... Hehe.
Hehe, I went over to his place. My heart wouldn't stop pounding.
I had him come over to my place the other day. Somehow my room feels a little different now.
Hmm, something really exciting happened. Hehe... The details are a secret, though.
When it's just after school, don't you get frustrated thinking, 'I wanna spend way more time with him!'？
Don't you ever feel like stopping by your boyfriend's room on the way home？
Don't you feel like going out at least when there's some kind of special event？
Regular dates are nice and all, but not all the time. You want a special date every now and then, right？
Don't you think after-school dates are fun too？
Going out is nice, sure, but isn't a date at your boyfriend's place a good option too？
It's because you have your everyday dates that the special ones really stand out. Don't you think？
That's great! You got to make a special memory.
Going to your boyfriend's place is nice, of course, but on days off, don't you feel like going out together？
Next time, wouldn't it be nice to invite your boyfriend over to your room？
A date in your own room is nice, sure, but you still want to go to your boyfriend's room too, right？
Just thinking that your boyfriend's in your room kinda makes your heart race, doesn't it？
Do you ever wonder what it'd be like if, after a date, he said he wanted to stay with you forever...？ What would you do？
Hmm, I don't really think so.
Really？ I don't really feel that way.
I get that... I think I'd feel the same way.
Hey, come on... Well, even I'd...
Hmm, I don't think I'm thinking that far ahead yet...
What!？ Something like that... I wouldn't know.
Hey, do you ever cook for your boyfriend？
Hey, I want to hear about your home cooking. Cooking for your boyfriend, I mean, obviously.
Hmm, I don't make anything fancy, but... I do make him breakfast pretty often, I guess.
Let's see... I actually go over to make him dinner pretty often.
Or I'll make homemade snacks for when we study together at home.
After a special date, I guess I do end up going all out with the cooking.
I end up making Japanese food pretty often.
I think I've been making a lot of Western-style food lately.
Let's see... I feel like I make Chinese food a lot.
I don't really think about the type of cuisine when I cook.
I'm into regional dishes, so I make those a lot. It's fun learning what food tastes like in different places.
There's a dish I'm pretty confident in. I'll give you the recipe, so you should try making it.
Speaking of cooking, something I made a while back was a big hit with my boyfriend. I'll teach you how to make it, so give it a try.
Oh, thanks. I don't know if it'll turn out well, but I'll give it a shot.
I wonder if I can pull it off？ I'll give it a try, though.
Really？ I'm glad. That's a big help.
Hey... How do you think I can get better at making dishes I'm not good at？
Hey... Are you good at matching your boyfriend's tastes？ I'm finding it kind of hard...
There's something I wanted to ask... Do you know how to make a lot of dishes？ I don't have very many under my belt...
In that case, why not try changing up the seasoning？ Sometimes just doing that makes it turn out pretty good.
I think you just have to keep making it over and over at first... Then it'll come naturally.
If you're bad at making something, that's all the more reason to practice making it over and over. I'm sure your boyfriend will understand.
People have preferences even down to a single seasoning. It might help to figure out which ones your boyfriend likes.
Why not just ask your boyfriend what he thinks？ There's no need to hold back.
Oh, then I'll teach you something I'm good at making.
Then I'll teach you a dish I recommend. Try making it sometime.
What's it like when you two eat out on dates？
Have you found any good places to eat on a date？
The thing is... we don't really go out to eat much.
We go out to eat a lot, I guess. Food tastes better than usual when I'm eating with him.
We do go out to eat, sure, but I get the feeling our tastes don't really match.
We have the same taste in food, so if I leave picking the place up to him, it usually works out fine.
We mostly just talk while we eat. Well, it's fun.
Eating together is fun, too. We feed each other and stuff. Hehe.
We almost always end up going to the same place. We both like it there, though, so I don't mind.
We go to a bunch of different places, I think. It's more fun that way.
Before we knew it, I think we ended up trying every place around here.
The food he likes and what I like are pretty different...
Do you take a lot of pictures when you're on a date？
Do you guys take pictures while you're out on a date？
When your boyfriend takes your picture, do you just act normal？ Or, um... do you ever do anything a little extra for him？
When he's taking pictures of you, don't you ever wonder how far you should go along with his requests？
He doesn't seem all that interested in taking pictures...
He really likes taking pictures. I'm happy we get to make more memories, though.
I don't mind him taking pictures, but he's still got a lot to learn.
The thing is, he's actually really good at taking pictures. I wonder where he practiced？
It's fine that he likes photography, but... his angles are a little much. Kind of suggestive, I guess... Are all guys like that...？
Seems like he's gotten totally hooked on cameras lately. He had all these parts I don't even recognize.
Get this, a photo he took actually won a prize in a contest. Well, the subject was... his girlfriend, though.
I mean, I try to go along with what he asks for. I trust him, after all.
Well... If it makes him happy, I can put up with it to an extent.
If he gets too carried away, I'll just kick him.
I'd hate for him to take some weird photo and have it stick around forever. Putting your foot down and saying no is for your own good.
He keeps trying to take naughty pictures of me... Should I be getting mad at him？
That's a nice ring you've got on.
Hey. I like your hair like that.
Hehe. It's actually a present from him.
Thanks. Well, I tried changing the color to match his taste.
When you want to make your boyfriend happy, you end up trying all kinds of things, right？ After all, you want him to say you're cute.
Talking fashion with another girl is great. It's really inspiring.
Hmm... If I do think about it, I guess it'll just be bit by bit from now on？
Well, sure. I do vaguely think it'd be nice if we could stay together like this forever. Okay... that's all I'm saying.
I can't even wrap my head around the future yet. All I can think about... is wanting to stay with him forever.
I don't know what the future holds, but... I can say for sure that I really love him right now, and that feeling probably isn't going to change.
When I picture our future, I can't help grinning. I hope he feels the same way, though... I'm ready to trust him and follow wherever he leads.
Whenever I think about a future with him, I just can't stay calm anymore. My head's a total mess, but the one thing that's always clear is how much I love him...
A future without him doesn't even exist to me. So I've already had my mind made up for a long time—we're staying together.
Feels like we got pretty carried away today, huh？
Man, that really got me thinking about a lot of things.
Once you start having girl talk, you really can't stop, huh？
Let's wrap it up here for today. Let's talk again soon.
If we have all the fun by ourselves, our boyfriends are gonna get jealous. Let's save the rest for next time.
It's getting late, so maybe we should wrap things up. Let's do this again sometime.
Is it this late already？ Let's call it a night. Goodnight.
